source.reuse: Factual observations paraphrased with attribution; no open-data licence asserted.

collectionFacility.name: Salt Spring Island Recycling Depot
collectionFacility.address: 349 Rainbow Road, Salt Spring Island, BC

observations.relationship: Accepted at depot under Recycle BC program
observations.basis: Operator states residential-only intake; commercial and institutional users excluded from these bins.

observations.material: Leftover household paint, stains, pesticides, poisons and flammable liquids
observations.basis: Operator identifies the depot as a BC ProductCare collection location.

limitations: Collection destination is evidenced. Downstream processors and final treatment destinations are not identified by this source.
No household mass, island-wide coverage total, transport route, ferry route or final recycling recovery rate is supplied.
Hartland as destination for Salt Spring household residual garbage was not verified from a primary source in this bounded research. Do not render a confirmed Salt Spring→Hartland edge.
Page currently says scrap metal and large appliances are not accepted; do not treat copper scrap as accepted here.
